nativeStaticEvidence.observation: The non-onscreen SCWindow branch uses the selected window ID and SCWindow.frame before calling captureScreenshotWithSkyLight.
The accelerated screenshot helper passes ignoreGlobalClipShape into WindowServerSPI.captureWindowImagesInRect and returns its first image.

The WindowServer wrapper calls an indirectly resolved OS entrypoint with a window-ID array, options, rect and connection. The hashed SoftLink lookup does not yield a plain-text symbol name in these dossiers.

nextAcceptance: Use a separate fixture window with .canJoinAllApplications to test ordinary background capture, preserving this transformed Stage Manager limitation. Do not modify third-party window behavior or global Stage Manager settings.
limits: These independent OS API probes do not establish how a complete official application behaves under the same scenario. Static native evidence is not execution evidence.
